{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3

|gr1= Stamina System

|descr= Returns current size of weapon sway of a given unit, in [[rad|radians]]. This command may still return a value greater 0 even if sway was effectively set to 0 with <sqf inline>player setCustomAimCoef 0;</sqf>.

|s1= [[getWeaponSway]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Number]] - weapon sway

|x1= <sqf>_sway = getWeaponSway player;</sqf>
